product_attributes.value_text: Free core application with no sign-up; Sync and Publish are optional paid services.

Free local editor and Cloud Basic; paid Cloud plans, an AI add-on and a one-time Believer offer have separate terms. The editor is MIT-licensed; the EE backend has separate authorization requirements for modification, compilation or redistribution. Check current plan prices and limits.

Native desktop local content is the offline comparison scope. Desktop and mobile feature coverage differs; Cloud sync and collaboration require connectivity. Notion HTML/Markdown import is supported but not all features map one-to-one; review converted content. Editor and EE backend licensing differ.

Local vault and Markdown note concepts require learning. Optional Sync and Publish are paid services; community extensions may add complexity. This compares basic personal notes, not full Notion databases or tested migration.

page.name: Obsidian

routes.name: Simple Notion Alternatives
routes.description: Compare basic personal note capture, editing and organization in Joplin, Obsidian and Simplenote without configuring structured databases or plugins. Notion itself also supports ordinary pages; simplicity is a workflow fit, not a measured speed advantage or complete feature replacement. Local notebooks, Markdown vaults and account-based sync have different setup and data-handling limits.

page.name: AFFiNE

routes.name: Notion Alternatives Without AI
routes.description: Personal offline notes and locally available organized content in installed native apps, without activating optional AI tools. AFFiNE, AppFlowy and Anytype offer overlapping personal workflows; this is not full Notion parity, an AI-free interface promise, or a privacy/processing guarantee. Optional AI and agent integrations have separate setup and data-handling terms.

routes.name: Offline Notion Alternatives
routes.description: Personal offline notes and locally available organized content in installed native workspaces. Compare AFFiNE desktop documents and whiteboards, Anytype local objects, and AppFlowy native offline mode. Notion also supports prepared offline pages in desktop/mobile apps. Cloud sync, hosted imports, remote attachments and collaboration have separate requirements. This does not guarantee complete Notion parity or full cloud-content availability offline.

anchors.name: Notion
anchors.description: Personal offline note and object organization only. Native desktop local documents, databases and whiteboards after installation. Cloud synchronization needs connectivity; mobile and browser parity are not established. No guarantee of full Notion feature, team or migration parity.
